def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Each diagonal stroke denotes a horizontal/diagonal stripe color. Extend
    # each observed diagonal down-right along constant column-row offset.
    out = [row[:] + [0] * (w-len(row)) for row in grid]
    marks = [(r, c, v) for r in range(h) for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if c >= len(grid[r]) or grid[r][c] == 0:
                # Fill by the nearest parallel diagonal (constant c-r),
                # using its known color at a point along that diagonal.
                candidates = [(abs((c-r)-(mc-mr)), mr, mc, v) for mr, mc, v in marks]
                d, mr, mc, v = min(candidates)
                out[r][c] = v
    return out
